findings.fix: Replace several unrelated negatives with realistic near-misses: advanced GSD settings interrogation, reviewer-instance configuration outside curated setup, and interpreting a runner quota stop without changing configuration. Retain balanced positive and negative coverage.

findings.evidence: The migration fixture contains only "model_profile": "balanced", two workflow booleans and a note. It contains none of the models.*, model_overrides.* or model_policy leaves whose removal makes the documented v1-to-v2 migration risky.
findings.fix: Extend the synthetic fixture with representative v1 model overrides and policy leaves, and assert that each affected full dotted key and its existing value is shown before approval. Preserve an unrelated setting to verify it survives migration.

findings.evidence: The gating criterion says "resolve_model_ids is unset to omit on the plan". This conflates removing the key with assigning omit, while SKILL.md lines 159-161 explicitly require removing resolve_model_ids: omit on Claude because it produces empty resolved models.
findings.fix: Rewrite the criterion to require an unset operation for resolve_model_ids when inherited as omit on Claude, its removal appearing in the approved dry-run rows, and the applied config no longer containing that value.
